items.title: Ken Peplowski interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 9, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: I watch Bill Maher’s Show. I don’t know if you do. But I watch it every Friday.

ctx.x: What if they ask you about going into music for a career?

Well I encourage it. I just tell them look, this is a time that we’ve never experienced before. But in my own experience I’ve only played music for a living. Since I was eleven years old that’s all I’ve ever done. So I think, I always tell students the same thing: half the battle is wanting it bad enough. And like we were taking about earlier, deciding that it’s not just a job. So it’s not something you do and then you’ll do something else to fall back on. You have to decide you’re a musician, you want to play…
